metadata.title: Nvidia's stock is down 10% upon news of Huang's exit - MarketWatch

content.text:
55 min ago
Nvidia's stock is down 10% upon news of Huang's exit
Nvidia shares are off 10% in Thursday's premarket trading as investors assess the implications of CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.
AMD shares are up 2.7%, while Broadcom shares are up 2.3%.
